name: Fujairah City Centre
tagline: The practical core with the shops and the fort
description: The commercial centre inland from the corniche, with the malls, the souq, the hospital and most of the ordinary apartment stock. Fujairah Fort and the old village sit at its northern edge. It is where daily life happens and where rents are lowest in the city.
bestFor: Longer stays where price and services matter
pros: Malls, supermarkets and the hospital nearby
Fujairah Fort and the heritage village close
cons: No sea view or beach access on foot
Hot and unwalkable for half the year

name: Corniche and Al Faseel
tagline: The seafront strip with the hotels
description: The coastal road running north from the port, with the beach, the promenade, the hotels and the restaurants that come with them. It is the most pleasant part of the city to be in and the only stretch where walking in the evening is genuinely enjoyable.
bestFor: Anyone who wants the sea at the door and the hotel infrastructure
pros: Beach and promenade on the doorstep
The hotels here have the best connections
cons: More expensive than the city centre
Port traffic and bunkering ships offshore
Busy at weekends with visitors from Dubai

name: Al Aqah
tagline: The resort beach with the island offshore
description: A stretch of coast about forty minutes north, with the emirate's main resort hotels facing a good beach and Snoopy Island, the rock formation just offshore that is the country's best-known snorkelling and shore diving site. Almost everything here serves visitors.
bestFor: Divers and snorkellers who want the reef at the door
pros: Shore diving and snorkelling at Snoopy Island
The best beach in the emirate
cons: Nothing outside the hotels for daily needs

name: Dibba Al Fujairah
tagline: The northern town and the boats to Musandam
description: A town at the northern end of the emirate where the mountains meet the sea, split administratively between three authorities, and the departure point for dive boats heading up the Musandam coast. It is quieter and more local than the resort strip south of it.
bestFor: Serious divers and anyone wanting a local town on the coast
pros: Access to the Musandam dive sites
More local and cheaper than the resorts
cons: Crossing between emirates and Oman needs planning

name: Sakamkam and Merashid
tagline: Residential districts inland from the centre
description: The residential areas spreading inland from the city towards the mountains, mostly villas and older apartment blocks housing the emirate's working population. Rents are the lowest in Fujairah and the wadis and mountain roads start at the edge of the built area.
bestFor: Budget stays with a car and no need for a sea view
pros: The cheapest housing in the emirate
Quick access to the mountain wadis
cons: A car is essential for everything
No beach or corniche access on foot
Very few shops or cafes locally
